lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Come on, Vegeta. I can see it deep in your soul.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Let me give you what you want.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: All the power that you need to defeat Goku.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You know, funny thing is, I know you're playing him.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: Wait, no. Don't tell me that Vegeta has got this in his heart.
